children.name: add_file
children.label: Add file
children.tip: Pick a file, archive it, and get its shareable file: token.

children.name: find_hash
children.label: Find a file
children.tip: Fetch a file by its file: token (local network, Blossom) or a magnet: link (BitTorrent swarm).

children.name: library
children.tip: Every file in the device's content-addressed archive. Tap an entry for details.

name: Sharing
tip: Make your archive available to others.

children.name: provide
children.tip: Two transports: Blossom HTTP for devices on the same local network, and BitTorrent for anyone across the internet.

children.name: blossom_on
children.label: Share on the local network (Blossom)
children.tip: Serve GET /<sha256> over HTTP so nearby devices can scan this port and fetch your files. NOSTR-Blossom compatible.

children.name: uploads_on
children.label: Accept uploads (PUT /upload)
children.tip: Allow others to store files on this device. Uploads are keyed by their own hash, so nobody can overwrite an existing file.

children.name: seed_on
children.label: Seed over BitTorrent (internet)
children.tip: Create a deterministic torrent for every archived file and announce it to well-known public trackers + the DHT, so devices on other networks can fetch it from the swarm via its magnet link.

children.name: share_apply
children.label: Apply sharing
children.tip: Start/stop the transports with the settings above.
